items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: with Melvin Wright and Jack Richards, a white talent player, and Martínez on piano. And did y'all have a guitar or a bass or anything in that band?

ctx.x: This is Real 4 Bob Watts, February the 28th, 1963. There are some things I wanted to ask you about. I'll go right ahead. One thing, he showed me a picture of the band in 1941, Alfred did, in fact we got it up at school, with Melvin Wright and Jack Richards, a white talent player, and Martínez on piano. And did y'all have a guitar or a bass or anything in that band? There's a guy sitting on the stand and I can't see where his instruments.
No, no, we never used a bass. But sometime a bass player would come in and set in.
